title: Rippling’s coding workload, at the two shares that were named
intro: Parker Conrad said OpenAI’s share of Rippling’s coding workload rose from 16% to 52%, while Anthropic’s fell from 57% to 18%. Switch between those two reported points. Nothing here is estimated.
note: These are shares of one company’s coding workload, as Conrad reported them. The Decoder retold the figures from The Information. Other coding work sits outside the OpenAI and Anthropic shares in each snapshot.
